1) Differences (short):
- Hosted API: multi-tenant, lowest time-to-value, transparent performance profiles. Good for early usage; we mitigate noisy neighbors with dynamic routing and request shaping, but you can see occasional higher tail when global demand spikes. Typical p95 for 512-token generation on hosted is ~120–180ms depending on model and region.
- Dedicated Capacity: reserved GPU pools for your account only. Strong isolation (single-tenant pool), predictable throughput, lower tail variance. p95 typically improves by ~20–40% over shared in comparable configs.
- Private VPC / On-prem: full network isolation, customer-managed infra; best for regulated data and strict network controls.

2) Attached is a short perf summary we can use as a starting point (perf-benchmarks.pdf). I'll have our SE run a targeted benchmark against your projected token sizes to provide exact p95/p99.

Carlos — quick follow-up with the concrete info I promised. Below are conservative ranges and our proposed next steps.

> On 2026-07-14 at 9:12 AM, Carlos wrote:
> > Can you share any p95/p99 numbers you have for hosted vs dedicated under similar token lengths?

Short answers (baseline numbers, 512-token generation, standard gpt-style model):
- Hosted API (multi-tenant): p50 ~ 60–80ms, p95 ~ 120–180ms, p99 ~ 300–700ms (varies with region and burst load). Typical steady-state throughput supports ~150–300 RPS depending on model.
- Dedicated Capacity (single-tenant GPU pool): p50 ~ 45–65ms, p95 ~ 80–120ms, p99 ~ 150–300ms. Tail is significantly reduced because you avoid cross-tenant interference and we can tune kernel selection / batching for your workload.

Isolation guarantees / boundaries:
- Dedicated capacity provides single-tenant GPU pools (no other customers' inference jobs run on the same pool). Network isolation via VPC peering (for Private deployments) or customer-specific subnets for Dedicated in our managed offering.
- Noisy neighbor risk on Dedicated: minimal to none for inference (we do not colocate unrelated tenants on the same GPU resources). Remaining sources of variance are model-specific kernel scheduling and upstream network spikes; we mitigate via autoscale policies and request shaping.

SLA & credits:
- We offer a 99.9% uptime SLA for Dedicated capacity with a standard crediting structure (detailed language attached). For Hosted API we provide published performance profiles and best-effort availability (we can discuss upgraded SLAs for larger commitments).

Attachments: perf-benchmarks.pdf (summary charts) and SOC2-questions.xlsx (procurement checklist). I'll also share our SOC2 Type II report via secure link once procurement signs an NDA; for initial reviews the checklist should be sufficient.

Pricing (ballpark):
- Dedicated monthly committed pool (estimated) to meet your 50 RPS interactive + overnight batch: $XXk–$YYk / month depending on GPU class (A100 vs H100) and retention policy. We will provide an exact TCO after we size the pool to your token distribution and concurrency profile.
